about: CV line test cases for the checks in handover/rubrics/cv-line-checks.md. Each case is one suggested CV line for the fictional entry below (Halima, the team's shared person; the number is a sample answer, not from the shared mock data), with the outcome the checks must give. tests/handover.test.cjs runs every case through server/cv/validate.js checkBullet. Add a case when you change a rule.
